plan.environment: the shelter dining hall in warm low afternoon sun: tall barred windows on the left wall glowing gold over a grey wood-plank wall, one long wooden table running to a far open doorway with one long white paper roll unrolled flat down its centre, a blue-and-white tiled counter on the right, brown chairs along both sides
plan.emotional_guidance: Valence: quiet, searching, then sinking. Arousal: low and still.
plan.visual_style: finished full-colour 3D animation, identical in look, lighting and character design to the first frame; the drawings on the roll are children's crayon drawings in soft pastel colours, never a sketch

audio.sounds: P01 crayons scratching faintly on paper further down the table; P02 a soft chair creak and the quiet air of the big hall; P03 a faint paper rustle as the camera glides along the roll
audio.room: the big hall in warm afternoon air, soft and a little hollow

panels.video_beat: Maria sits very still in the left foreground, her eyes fixed down the long roll, lips closed; the camera starts a slow low glide forward along the roll, past her
drawings everywhere: rows of small drawn families slide by on the roll, and the first to pass is a drawn mom with long brown hair holding the hands of two drawn children
next a drawn dad in a white shirt with big brown shoes standing beside a drawn mom with brown hair
the glide slows and settles on a drawn grandma with grey hair and a big purple purse beside a drawn dad with big shoes; more drawn families stretch away along the roll to the far doorway

plan.continuity: Maria, seated in her window-side seat at the long table in the left foreground at first, then behind the camera; the crayon boy in the next seat on her side, drawing on his own small sheet; across the table the jersey boy and the girl with two braids, drawing on their own small sheets; all four stay in their seats and pass out of the frame; no other child, no adult and no robot in the room
preventions: no robot, machine or robot-like figure on any drawing: the drawings show families of people only
one single long roll of paper down the table, never separate sheets or a second table
Maria's lips never form words and she never leaves her seat
exactly four children at the start, none added and none moved, every other chair empty
the far doorway stays empty, nobody stands in it
no writing or letters on any drawing
